data.narrative:
Kraken Robotics is a publicly listed company in the Defense & Security sector. The broader comp universe contains 23 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 identifiable private firms. The private peer set includes Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, representing a range of development and commercialization stages within defense robotics and autonomous systems.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to Kraken Robotics in this analysis. The Defense & Security sector lacks a sufficiently dense comparable set at matching stage and valuation tier; only one same-stage peer was identified, falling well short of the minimum three datapoints required for robust median triangulation. A sector-wide median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity in company maturity, revenue scale, and technology focus across the 23-company universe. Adjacent-stage and similar-valuation-tier filters yielded no additional qualified peers.

Given data constraints, triangulation via traditional peer multiples cannot be supported. Valuation assessment would require alternative methods not covered in the current dataset—such as discounted cash flow modeling, precedent transaction analysis, or venture-backed private comparable multiples—or expansion of the comp set to capture sufficient same-stage Defense & Security peers. Without such additional inputs, no specific valuation range can be derived from the available information.
